verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's docs include a quickstart for completing a test payment with the Payments API v3 using a free merchant account, and the Pay by Bank docs list testing as a covered topic. This points to a first-party test mode, but the evidence never explicitly names a sandbox environment or says it is isolated from production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox environment separate from production, details of sandbox credentials/endpoints and mock banks, coverage of sandbox testing beyond payments (e.g. Data/Verification APIs), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: you'll create a free UK merchant account and complete your first test payment with the Payments API v3
Accept Pay by Bank payments. Covers the API, authentication, webhooks and testing.
